description: This is a 3D model of a green inflatable tube man, often referred to as an air dancer or sky dancer. It features a long, segmented body that is flexible and designed to sway and move with air currents. The figure has simple, cartoonish eyes and a smiling mouth drawn onto its head. Its limbs are also made of the same inflatable material, giving it a whimsical and energetic appearance. The design mimics the type of inflatable advertising characters commonly seen outside businesses to attract attention. The model is presented against a plain, light gray background, isolating the object for clear viewing.
